_why: AXIS 1 (R-490 section3-2): 15 outcomes x 2 POSITIONS. The corpus already exercised 14 of the 15
outcomes in entry_conditions (00-control-shipped) and exactly ONE row in invalidations
(INVALIDATE / 'structure break'). So 15 of the 30 cells were covered and the WHOLE
invalidations POSITION was represented by a single family.
THIS FIXTURE CLOSES THE OTHER HALF: all 15 outcomes appear in invalidations, and INVALIDATE --
the one family that had never appeared in entry_conditions -- appears there.
WHY THIS POSITION IS THE ONE WORTH EXERCISING, from the gate's own docstring (:24-28): the OLD
comparator's TS shape function 'never EMITTED invalidation_bindings or queue_reasons at all,
while Python's to_dict() emits both. Those two keys were not under-compared, they were
STRUCTURALLY ABSENT from one side.' invalidation_bindings is therefore the exact array whose
absence made the original false green possible, and until now one row of one family was the
most it ever carried. Fifteen rows compared ELEMENTWISE AT INDEX is what makes that key load-
bearing rather than merely present.
ROLE DISCIPLINE: spine is exactly sess + enter, so spine_total/spine_bound/compiled stay
derivable from an authority-adjudicated session row + P-5 (2/2 = 1.000 >= 0.5). The INVALIDATE
row sits in confluence so it cannot move an adjudicated scalar. Invalidations do not enter the
spine/confluence tallies at all -- they are collected into their own array.
ORACLE SCOPE: authority section6 puts invalidations bindings OUT of scope, so every row in the
invalidations array carries NO correctness expectation. AGREEMENT between the lanes is fully
enforced on all 15, which is the claim this fixture exists to make checkable.
